UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Root user profile document for an authenticated Minna Bunpou learner, admin, or superadmin.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Optional learner display name shown in the header, account menu, and monitoring panel.

email.description: Normalized lowercase email address from Firebase Auth (auto-healed for legacy users).

avatarUrl.description: Optional avatar URL (HTTPS or compressed JPEG/PNG/WebP data URI).

role.description: 3-tier RBAC role. Bootstrap superadmin jrenghaha2@gmail.com is permanently superadmin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile or role update.

BunpouBookProgress.title: BunpouBookProgress
BunpouBookProgress.description: Per-book mastered and hard Minna Bunpou pattern IDs synced for a learner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

bookId.description: Minna Bunpou book identifier matching the document ID (n5 or n4).

mastered.description: Unique list of mastered Bunpou pattern IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from hard).

hard.description: Unique list of hard/review Bunpou pattern IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from mastered).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this book progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest progress sync.

BunpouQuizHistory.title: BunpouQuizHistory
BunpouQuizHistory.description: Per-book compact detailed quiz answer history (up to 30 latest sessions) stored as pure ASCII reference tokens including selected choice and example index.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

bookId.description: Minna Bunpou book identifier matching the document ID (n5 or n4).

sessions.description: Up to 30 compact pure-ASCII quiz session tokens with per-question detailed answer records (V1 legacy and V2 detailed with selectedPatternId & exampleIndex).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this quiz history bucket was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest quiz history sync.

KotobaBookProgress.title: KotobaBookProgress
KotobaBookProgress.description: Per-book mastered and hard Minna Kotoba vocabulary word IDs synced for a learner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

bookId.description: Minna Kotoba book identifier matching the document ID (n5 or n4).

mastered.description: Unique list of mastered Kotoba word IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from hard).

hard.description: Unique list of hard/review Kotoba word IDs belonging to bookId (disjoint from mastered).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when this Kotoba progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest Kotoba progress sync.

DailyStudyTracker.title: DailyStudyTracker
DailyStudyTracker.description: Daily memorization goal, streak, and up to 90 days of compact pure-ASCII activity tokens synced for a learner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

dailyGoal.description: Daily memorization goal selected by the learner.

days.description: Up to 90 compact pure-ASCII daily activity tokens (YYYY-MM-DD|quizSessions|id1,id2,...).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the daily tracker document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest daily tracker sync.

LiveActivity.title: LiveActivity
LiveActivity.description: Real-time presence, active study module, live quiz progress, and summary stats for an authenticated user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name snapshot for real-time monitoring list.

moduleLabel.description: Human-readable label of the current study module.

quizInProgress.description: Whether the user is currently answering an active quiz.

quizBookId.description: Active quiz book ID when quizzing.

quizCorrectCount.description: Running correct answer count in active quiz (0..50).

quizFromChapter.description: Start chapter of active quiz scope (0..50).

quizToChapter.description: End chapter of active quiz scope (0..50).

quizPatternId.description: Active Bunpou pattern ID currently being tested (or empty string when idle).

quizExampleIndex.description: Example sentence index (0..3) used for the active live quiz question.

quizChoiceIds.description: Up to 4 unique Bunpou pattern IDs representing the exact ordered answer choices shown to the learner.

quizSelectedChoiceId.description: Pattern ID chosen by the learner for the current live question, or empty string before answering.

quizLiveAnswers.description: Up to 50 compact pure-ASCII tokens recording all answered questions so far in the ongoing quiz session.

totalMasteredBunpou.description: Total mastered Bunpou patterns across N5 and N4.

totalMasteredKotoba.description: Total mastered Kotoba words across N5 and N4.

totalQuizSessions.description: Total completed quiz sessions across N5 and N4.

lastQuizScore.description: Latest quiz percentage score (0..100, or -1 if none).

lastQuizSummary.description: Compact summary of the latest completed quiz.

currentStreak.description: Current daily study streak in days.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest heartbeat or state transition.

ActivityEvent.title: ActivityEvent
ActivityEvent.description: Append-only chronological log of significant learning and quiz events for real-time admin monitoring.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the learner who triggered the event.

detail.description: Event detail including scope, score, or milestone summary.

score.description: Percentage score (0..100) for quiz_completed, or -1 otherwise.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the event was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Root profile & RBAC role document for each authenticated user (Master Gate parent for all subcollections).

/users/{userId}/bunpouProgress/{bookId}.description: Per-book mastered and hard Bunpou pattern progress (n5, n4).

/users/{userId}/quizHistory/{bookId}.description: Per-book compact quiz session history tokens (n5, n4).

/users/{userId}/kotobaProgress/{bookId}.description: Per-book mastered and hard Kotoba vocabulary progress (n5, n4).

/users/{userId}/dailyTracker/{trackerId}.description: Singleton ('state') daily memorization target, streak, and 90-day activity history.

/liveActivity/{userId}.description: Real-time presence, live quiz progress, and summary stats per user.

/activityEvents/{eventId}.description: Append-only chronological stream of quiz starts, quiz completions, and study progress milestones.
